why: p is all zeros, but only because counts[j] / outDegree is integer division (2/5 = 0, 1/5 = 0). The student does not see this and calls the zero row fine, claiming the page has no links. The page does have links, since counts sums to 5. The row sums to 0, not 1, so it is not a probability row and needs a double division such as (double) counts[j] / outDegree. The student's reading is a wrong interpretation with no working model of the division rule.
